title: Fulcio：憑證SAN與OIDC發行者的雙重身分綁定
titleEn: Fulcio: binding certificate SAN to OIDC issuer identity
subcategoryTitle: 軟體來源證明與透明度
summary: 建立14份公開憑證描述，保留SAN、OIDC issuer擴充、EKU與簽章時間；另列CA發行者名稱，明確區別X.509 issuer與OIDC issuer。

Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Fulcio以憑證表達簽署者身分；本課檢查SAN與OIDC issuer共同政策，避免把相同顯示名稱或不同發行者的相同subject混為一人。
knowledge.textEn: Fulcio certificates carry signer identity. Evaluate SAN and OIDC issuer together, preventing equal display names or equal subject strings under different identity providers from being treated as the same authorized release signer.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立14份公開憑證描述，保留SAN、OIDC issuer擴充、EKU與簽章時間；另列CA發行者名稱，明確區別X.509 issuer與OIDC issuer。
knowledge.textEn: Build 14 public certificate descriptors with SAN, OIDC issuer extension, EKU and signing time. Record the CA issuer name separately, explicitly distinguishing an X.509 issuer from the identity-provider issuer used by the signer policy.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本地政策要求SAN與OIDC發行者精確匹配，且先通過鏈與用途檢查；不能把issuer的字串部分比對或顯示名稱當作穩定身分。
knowledge.textEn: The local policy requires exact SAN and OIDC issuer matches after chain and usage checks. Substring issuer matching and display-name comparison are not stable identity contracts and must not substitute for the selected typed certificate fields.
